answer: Registration alone never grants a vote. Entry is a cosigned bond: the newcomer posts 0.5 ETH and three incumbents freeze 200 POA each behind the vouch, a velvet cushion with a razor underneath, since liability rides with the signature. Fake output and the slasher burns every bond up the chain. Applicants also do 20 paid jobs for strangers. A 10,000-sybil farm needs 5,000 ETH in bonds, 2M POA of incumbent exposure, and 60 days of real task time, where one forged result collapses the tree. Picture a lantern behind an ivory cage: three candles fit, cram a thousand and you hold ash.
